fluff.overview: Another type of infantry serving in the Sixty-seventh BattleMech Cluster is the Mechanized AA Point. Traveling in light wheeled tanks fitted with lightweight antiaircraft weapons, these troops screen supply dumps, artillery positions, and rear-area assets from aerial attack. They rarely see direct combat, and serious questions remain about how effective they would be against a determined VTOL strike, let alone an aerospace fighter attack run. During the conflict with Clan Ice Hellion, these AA Points took heavy losses from rapid strikes they simply lacked the speed to respond to, though they did succeed in their primary mission of keeping the tanks they protected untouched. It is a thin distinction, but for solahma warriors who never expected to survive their final posting, the mission was enough.
